intent: Logo animation: the rolling pin rolls a half turn across the mark, compressing slightly at the handles, while the wheat sprigs fan outward and spring back into symmetry.
Logo animation: the pick drops into place with a tiny squash, then the three strings sweep across from left to right like strummed bands.
The stair blocks rise upward in sequence like an escalator, then the metro circle draws attention with a smooth scale pop and settles into a clean transit mark.
The cat rides the conveyor belt while tightening a wobbling bolt with quick ratchet clicks; the belt loops steadily and the loose gear beside it gives a satisfied spin.
The cat drummer snaps into a short drum fill: both sticks alternate downstrokes on the toms, the cymbal wobbles after each hit, and the tail flicks sharply on the final beat.
The frog crouches, blinks, then springs upward on stretchy legs to sniff the flower; the flower head nods from the tiny impact and rebounds.
The garden shears snap closed around the tall stems with a crisp overshoot; the cut flower heads pop upward slightly, then tumble down with a playful rotation.
Logo animation: the seesaw pivots around the center triangle while the soccer ball hops from the low end to the high end, landing with playful easing.

The small spacecraft marker coasts along the elliptical transfer path from the inner orbit toward the outer planet, easing fastest near the sun and slower near apoapsis; the two planets advance slightly on their circular guide orbits.
Logo animation: the compact car squashes slightly on its tires, then does a cheerful two-hop bounce with the wheels lagging and settling into place.
Logo animation: the round owl badge rotates in from -12 degrees, both eye discs bounce into place sequentially, and the beak flips down to a crisp stop.

The raccoon pops out of the sidewalk trash can, lifting the lid like a hinged hat and blinking at the street. The lid wobbles on its pivot while the raccoon’s paws grip the rim and its head bounces up into view.
The rope is pulled down on the free end, causing the lower pulley and attached load to rise at half the rope speed; arrows emphasize the mechanical advantage.
The street bridge deck rotates upward around the left trunnion while the counterweight descends, with the dashed arc showing the deck tip path and a small bounce at the raised stop.
The crank turns twice, then the lid snaps open and the clown puppet springs upward with a stretchy overshoot before settling into a wobble.
When the switch closes, current runs through the coil and the compass needle swings toward the electromagnet, overshooting slightly before damping back.
The duck sailor rocks with the rowboat on a looping wave, tugging the tiller side to side; the mast flag flutters with a snappy two-frame feel.
The crab does a quick sideways shuffle across the sand, claws bobbing in alternating arcs and legs tapping with snappy easing.
Logo animation: the sailboat gently rocks on an invisible wave, the main sail bends a few degrees with the motion, then returns to a calm upright pose.
The bee follows the dashed loop from the left flower to the right flower, bobbing gently; pollen dots lift from the first blossom and settle onto the second as it arrives.
The basketball follows the dashed parabolic flight path toward the hoop, squashes lightly on the rim, then drops through the net with gravity-driven easing.
Logo animation: the comet streaks in along the curved trail with a squash-and-stretch head, the tail draws behind it, then the whole mark eases to a crisp stop.
The desk drawer glides straight outward along the dashed rails, eases past the halfway mark, and gives a small stop-and-settle bounce at full extension.
The frog student drops the cork into the beaker; it sinks a little, rebounds to the surface, and bobs gently while the frog's hands clap once.
The punch lever rotates down around the rear pivot, driving the two circular dies through the sheet; small paper chads drop vertically and bounce once on the desk line.
The bear chef lifts the spoon to taste the sauce, smiles after a tiny pause, and the pot lid gives a playful rattle from the simmering bubbles.
The spinner arrow whips around the dial, decelerates over several ticks, and lands on one wedge while the small token hops forward along the path squares.
The side paddle wheel turns clockwise, its buckets dipping through the water and pushing backward; the boat eases forward with a small bob as the dashed wake trails behind.
The octopus captain peers through the porthole as the submarine dives diagonally; tentacles wiggle against the glass and bubbles rise with staggered timing.
Mechanism diagram: the footboard is pressed down, rotating the hinge linkage so the beater swings forward and strikes the drum head, then springs back with a soft overshoot.
